audience: Dutch HR, finance and IT teams that read data from AFAS Profit through an app connector

useCases.title: List the connectors an environment exposes
useCases.text: List the GetConnectors that the app connector activates. Use the list to learn which connector names exist.

useCases.title: Learn the fields of a connector
useCases.text: Read the field names, types and lengths of one connector. Use them to build filters and sort orders.

useCases.title: Read records from a connector
useCases.text: Read records from one connector, with filters combined by AND, sorting and paging. Without a take value, AFAS returns 100 rows.

useCases.title: Page through large connector reads
useCases.text: Page with skip and take, or set both to -1 to read all rows. AFAS fair use applies to large reads.
